item.title: Scroll Progress Bar
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Scroll down this page: the progress bar along the bottom of the header fills as you go and is full when you reach the end. The header sticks to the top of the window so the bar stays in view.

The Sunlight Zone

Below two hundred metres, sunlight fades and the ocean changes character. Temperatures fall, pressure rises by one atmosphere every ten metres, and life adapts in ways that look strange from the surface. This paragraph is placeholder copy that exists to make the page long enough to scroll.
